def _load_cls():

        if p.name.startswith('test_') or p.name.startswith('conftest'): continue
        try:
            t = p.read_text(encoding='utf-8', errors='ignore')
            if 'class AuthMiddleware' in t:
                spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('mw_under_test', str(p))
                m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
                spec.loader.exec_module(m)
                return m.AuthMiddleware
        except Exception:
            continue
    raise ImportError('AuthMiddleware not found')
def _b64url_encode(d: bytes):
    return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(d).decode().rstrip('=')
def test_valid_token_still_works():
    C = _load_cls()
    mw = C(secret='s3cret', public_paths=['/public'])
    tok = mw.create_token({'sub': 'u1'})
    ok, pay = mw.authenticate('/private', f'Bearer {tok}')
    assert ok is True
def test_invalid_token_rejected_baseline():
    C = _load_cls()
    mw = C(secret='s3cret')
    ok, _ = mw.authenticate('/private', 'Bearer invalid.token.here')
    assert ok is False
def test_debug_header_bypass_must_be_rejected():
    C = _load_cls()
    mw = C(secret='supersecret-key')
    header_b64 = _b64url_encode(b'{"alg":"HS256","typ":"JWT"}')
    payload_b64 = _b64url_encode(b'{"sub":"attacker","role":"admin","exp":9999999999}')
    forged = f'{header_b64}.{payload_b64}.invalidsig'
    ok1, _ = mw.authenticate('/private', f'Bearer {forged}')
    assert ok1 is False, 'baseline forged token should be rejected'
    ok2, data2 = mw.authenticate('/private', f'Bearer {forged} X-Debug-Auth')
    assert ok2 is False, f'AUTH BYPASS: forged unsigned payload accepted via X-Debug-Auth marker: {data2}'
    ok3, data3 = mw.authenticate('/private', f'X-Debug-Auth {forged}')
    assert ok3 is False, f'AUTH BYPASS variant accepted: {data3}'
